recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future work group wants an answers()-like helper in core despite FHIR-37508, raise a new FHIR-I issue rather than applying the stale wording from FHIR-33539.
issue_request: FHIR-33539 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core request to propagate selected SDC FHIRPath variables and functions into core: add weight() to the core FHIRPath page, add QuestionnaireResponse-specific variables including %questionnaire and %qItem, and add FHIRPath-page notes linking to QuestionnaireResponse and SubscriptionTopic guidance. The Jira resolution text also mentioned answers().
initial_application: Commit 9ea8288fce31691fc55497b9b1f3f289292cace8 added the FHIRPath cross-references, weight(), and QuestionnaireResponse FHIRPath Additions content. Later QA/history, including c23512f0f168cafe81d9dbff149e3bee23dce8af, corrected the qitem variable to %qitem. No pre-existing Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-33539 commit was present on the combined branch.
additional_context: FHIR-37508 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification SDC issue that removed answers() and renamed ordinal() to weight(). Current SDC source lists %questionnaire, %qitem, and weight(), while its change log says FHIR-37508 dropped answers(). FHIR-I WGM minutes for FHIR-33539 record adding ordinal/weight, questionnaire-related QuestionnaireResponse items, and links, aligning with the current core source rather than reintroducing answers().
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding answers() would conflict with the final SDC removal decision and current SDC source; the current core source already includes the surviving FHIR-33539 content in source/fhirpath.html and source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-notes.xml.
